subject: The secret trick 90% of couples miss
preview_text: One tiny change that makes every date feel fresh again. Try it now.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when you're scrolling through date ideas and nothing feels right? It's not because there aren't good options. It's because you're looking at everything but missing one simple thing that changes everything.

Here's the trick: stop trying to plan the perfect date on your own. Instead, let your partner choose from a short list you curate together. It takes thirty seconds, but it shifts the whole vibe from pressure to excitement. You're not guessing anymore. You're collaborating.

That's exactly why SoulPlan has a shared wishlist feature. You each add ideas you'd actually love, and then the app surfaces the ones you both smiled at. No more awkward 'what do you want to do' conversations. Just a list that makes you both feel seen.

Open the app right now, add three date ideas to your shared wishlist, and watch your partner's reaction. P.S. If you add something adventurous and they add something cozy, you've already won. That contrast is where the magic happens.
cta_text: Open SoulPlan and add to your wishlist
